_readme: Tests skipped by tools/run_all_tests.mjs. Every entry needs a reason; remove it once fixed or deleted. PRs also skip the slow lists; the weekly run takes the slow lists (--with-slow) but still honours the quarantine, so it only goes red on new breakage. --all ignores this file for a manual full audit. A key with :: deselects one test.

python.tests/test_source_ledger_contract.py::So: data/source_ledger.json:482 起六个条目缺少 provenance_sidecar；仓库和生成器均无符合 tools/check_source_ledger.py:97-105 哈希契约的 sidecar，不可编造路径。
python.tests/test_tno_water_geometries.py::test: 入库 TNO 水域在被跟踪的相邻对之间存在缝隙；可能是真实数据缺陷，尚未判定是修几何还是更新相邻关系。

pythonSlow._reason: Each takes more than about 10 s on a fast workstation (roughly 2x on a 4-core CI runner); the weekly run takes them.

nodeSlow._reason: Single tests take 15-55 s on a fast workstation (roughly 2x on CI); the weekly run takes them.
